answer: Coordination Charge prices coordination itself with a per-session fee drawn from each agent’s payout, raised whenever an agent’s incoming links form a fast clique. The grove ledger requires every new node to solve the active clique’s hash at the quoted rate, so a velvet ploy loses its fee if the enclave aborts after one round. Each knoll entry costs a fresh attestation plus a refundable bid; a fresh account entering a low-value task still forfeits roughly one session fee on abort.
